mapper.select: SELECT id FROM capability_invocation WHERE investigation_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < #{startedBefore} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE capability_invocation SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, #{finishedAt}) DIV 1000, 0), updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id IN #{id} AND investigation_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'RUNNING'
